name: Indigo scarf
where: Casa de las Artesanías or CEDARTI
about: A traditional El Salvadoran scarf dyed with natural indigo. Indigo has long been a key craft of this region.
tip: Wash it separately the first few times, as the dye can bleed.

name: Ilobasco pottery
where: CEDARTI craft shop, San Salvador Centro Histórico
about: Hand-painted ceramics from the town of Ilobasco, known for scenes of everyday village life.
tip: Ask for extra wrapping, since these pieces break easily.

name: El Salvador coffee
about: Coffee grown in the country's highlands. It is a popular and easy-to-carry gift.
